name: student-project-monorepo
description: Monorepo root — orchestrates frontend (Vite) and backend (Express) workspaces. The root node_modules is used by the Vercel serverless function (api/index.js), so ALL backend dependencies must be listed here.

scripts.dev: start "Backend" cmd /k "cd backend && npm run dev" && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
